description: This Java class defines an immutable command object used for representing a single disbursal transaction within a loan portfolio system. It encapsulates details such as loan ID, transaction amount, and transaction date.

classes.name: SingleDisbursalCommand
classes.description: An immutable data transfer object representing a single disbursal command with loan ID, transaction amount, and date.

methods.name: SingleDisbursalCommand
methods.description: Constructor initializing the disbursal command with loan ID, transaction amount, and date.

methods.name: getLoanId
methods.description: Returns the loan ID associated with the disbursal.

methods.name: getTransactionAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount of the transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the transaction.
